plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he believes that a researcher named Thomas Townsend Brown was behind patents that were later bought by Sharper Image, a US gadget retailer, for its air purifiers that clean air using electrically charged particles. Michels tells it to show that Brown's odd-sounding work ended up in ordinary household products.
